title: Quick & Easy Indian Cooking

long_description:
Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.

About this Event

Age RestrictionsFor ages 18 & up

DescriptionIf you love Indian food and have wondered how to recreate those flavors in your own home, this is the class for you! While the South Asian/Indian culinary diaspora is incredibly diverse, we’re here to lessen the intimidation factor and help you get to know the key spices, knife skills, essential sauces, and cooking methods to get you started.
We’ll pay homage to Madhur Jaffrey, multiple James Beard Award-winner known as the Godmother of Indian Cooking for introducing many people to Indian food in America. Using her approach, we’ll keep class fun, easy, and delicious at every turn. At the end of class everyone will get to sit down and enjoy a meal together.
You will be working in a small group. For ages 18 and up. 21 or older? You’ll enjoy a glass of wine or beer paired with your meal.

MenuLamb Vindaloo
Shahi Murgh (Royal Chicken Cooked in Yogurt)
Massor Dal (Red Lentils Tarka)
Matar Aur Sooay Ka Pullao (Rice with Peas and Dill)
Hari Chutney (Fresh Green Chutney)
Sev ka Murabba (Carmelized Cardamom Apples with Pistachio Cream)

Safety & Precautions
At check-in, you will be asked to sign a waiver before entering the Cooking School.
For that reason, we ask that all attendees arrive at least 5 minutes prior to the confirmed start time of the class.
